deterministic_regression_bugs_verified.description: Unauthenticated BWS 99 (arg1 == 0xDEADBEEFCAFEULL) Ring 3 kernel stack overflow panic trigger removed from production builds and gated behind BURSZTYN_DEBUG_STACK_OVERFLOW_BWS + operacja_systemowa_dozwolona.
Fixed 160-byte buffer silent path truncation and missing pre-translation bezpieczna_sciezka validation on A/B slot-translated paths (/programy, /system).
Fixed missing uniqueness/aliasing validation across direct blocks, blok_posredni_1, blok_posredni_2, and indirect entries, plus root-inode directory cycle rejection.

Fixed 256-slot LRU data block cache eviction of indirect pointer table block (blok_posredni_1/blok_posredni_2) while freeing/zeroing >256 data blocks of a large file, which previously corrupted the indirect pointer table mid-loop and freed block 0.

Discovered by fuzz_bur_loader: when 'wersja' in opis.aplikacji was >= 32 bytes, pakiet_parsuj_manifest_tekst copied 32 bytes from a 64-byte temporary buffer into out_manifest->wersja[32] without a NUL terminator, causing C-string overread into adjacent struct fields; also left out_manifest uninitialized on early error return.

Discovered by test_bws_abuse_qemu.py: bws_rozmiar_pliku (BWS_ROZMIAR_PLIKU=44) unconditionally returned rozmiar_pliku(sciezka) + 1ULL (= 1ULL) even when sciezka was invalid (e.g. '/../../cytaty.txt'), non-existent, or a directory, causing Ring 3 pobierz_rozmiar_pliku() to report success with size 0. Fixed to verify pobierz_metadane_tworu(sciezka, &meta) && meta.typ == TYP_PLIK before returning meta.rozmiar + 1ULL.
